mobslearn.skill.zombie_builder.desc: They watched you pillar up and now build up themselves to reach you.
mobslearn.skill.zombie_swimmer.desc: Swim like dolphins. Boats won't save you.
mobslearn.skill.zombie_copycat.desc: Dress like you: your helmet, then boots, then chestplate.

mobslearn.skill.spider_web.desc: Spit webs: a hit can leave you stuck.

mobslearn.skill.spider_family.desc: Cave spiderlings pour out when one dies.
mobslearn.skill.enderman_behind.desc: Hiding under a roof? They teleport behind you.
mobslearn.skill.enderman_umbrella.desc: No longer afraid of water or rain.
mobslearn.skill.enderman_florist.desc: Carry flowers around. Sometimes TNT at level 3.
mobslearn.skill.witch_tank.desc: More health, Resistance from level 2, Regeneration at level 3.
mobslearn.skill.witch_broom.desc: Jump high and float down like on a broom.
mobslearn.skill.phantom_daylight.desc: Don't burn in the sun anymore.
mobslearn.skill.cow_gym.desc: Bigger and tougher: +15% size, +4 health per level.
mobslearn.skill.sheep_style.desc: Sheep spawn in random colors. Rainbow ones at level 3.
mobslearn.skill.chicken_fly.desc: Jump high, glide and scatter away from you.
mobslearn.skill.pig_escape.desc: Flee from armed players. Saddled at level 3.
mobslearn.skill.rabbit_fast.desc: Speed and jump boost. Good luck.
mobslearn.skill.villager_fear.desc: Run away when you hold a weapon.
mobslearn.skill.villager_gossip.desc: Recognize you and greet you in chat. Sometimes rudely.
mobslearn.skill.cat_gift.desc: Tamed cats bring you presents. Weird ones.
mobslearn.skill.parrot_mimic.desc: Parrots repeat what you say in chat.
mobslearn.skill.bee_angry.desc: Take honey and the bees attack.
mobslearn.skill.fish_smart.desc: Faster fish with names. Smart names.
mobslearn.skill.world_names.desc: Mobs sometimes spawn with their own names.
mobslearn.skill.world_talk.desc: Hostile mobs comment when they spot you.

mobslearn.wiki.title: World Learns — wiki
mobslearn.wiki.hero.tagline: The world learns and grows on its own.
mobslearn.wiki.hero.sub: Mobs pick up your habits, villagers and monsters build settlements, make friends, wage war and gossip. Every world lives its own life.
mobslearn.wiki.how.title: How it works
mobslearn.wiki.how.sub: Just play: the world watches and learns. You can adjust the mod in the Knowledge menu.
mobslearn.wiki.how.1.title: You play
mobslearn.wiki.how.1.text: You swing swords, build pillars, milk cows, run from creepers. The world writes it all down.
mobslearn.wiki.how.2.title: Mobs learn
mobslearn.wiki.how.2.text: Repeat a habit and mobs gain a skill. Every skill has three levels.
mobslearn.wiki.how.3.title: The world grows
mobslearn.wiki.how.3.text: Settlements build, make friends and fight even without you, and new mobs are born already trained.
mobslearn.wiki.mobs.title: Who learns what
mobslearn.wiki.mobs.sub: Click a card to open the mob's page with all of its skills.
mobslearn.wiki.absurd.title: Absurd skills
mobslearn.wiki.absurd.sub: Not everything mobs learn makes them deadlier. Some things just make the world... weirder.
mobslearn.wiki.intel.title: The smarter the world, the weirder
mobslearn.wiki.intel.sub: The overall share of learned skills. Special world-wide skills unlock at milestones.
mobslearn.wiki.intel.none: Join a world to see its intelligence
mobslearn.wiki.cmd.title: Commands
mobslearn.wiki.cmd.sub: Requires operator rights or cheats. Click a line to copy it.
mobslearn.wiki.faq.title: FAQ
mobslearn.wiki.faq.0.q: Do mobs learn from scratch in every world?
mobslearn.wiki.faq.0.a: Yes. Each world has its own memory, stored in mobslearn.json in the world folder. A new world starts empty.
mobslearn.wiki.faq.1.q: Do mobs that already exist get smarter?
mobslearn.wiki.faq.1.a: New enemies gain skills when they spawn. Existing zombies can pick up basic construction; animals and villagers keep learning over time.
mobslearn.wiki.faq.2.a: /mobslearn reset wipes the world's memory. Without commands — start a new world.
mobslearn.wiki.faq.3.a: Check the mobGriefing game rule: when it's off, mobs don't break or place blocks.
mobslearn.wiki.faq.4.a: Yes. Install it on the server and on clients. Without the mod a player has no notifications or knowledge tree, but mobs still learn.
mobslearn.wiki.faq.5.q: Where can I see what mobs know?
mobslearn.wiki.faq.5.a: Press K in game or click "Mob Knowledge" in the pause menu. Click any skill to see what it does, how it levels up and how much is left.
mobslearn.wiki.footer: Minecraft 26.3 · Fabric · made with love for weird mobs

mobslearn.wiki.group.creeper: Silent, fast and very touchy. Sometimes they apologize.
mobslearn.wiki.group.spider: Climb everything, weave webs and bring the whole family.

mobslearn.wiki.group.witch: Alchemy, broom flights and very nasty potions.

mobslearn.wiki.group.cow: Hide their milk, hit the gym and kick back. Touch one and the herd comes.
mobslearn.wiki.group.sheep: Fashionable, sometimes airborne, and they headbutt.
mobslearn.wiki.group.chicken: Learning to fly and to fire eggs back.
mobslearn.wiki.group.pig: See a sword, run. Later they ram you and dig up truffles.

mobslearn.help.title: How it works
mobslearn.help.sub: The 20-second version. Reopen this any time with the "?" button.
mobslearn.help.1.title: You play — the world watches
mobslearn.help.1.text: The world remembers how you treat mobs: what you hit them with, who you run from, who you feed and milk.
mobslearn.help.2.title: Habit = skill
mobslearn.help.2.text: Do the same thing many times and mobs learn to answer it. Every skill has 3 levels.
mobslearn.help.3.title: New mobs are already smart
mobslearn.help.3.text: Mobs that spawn later get the skills. The higher the skill level, the more often you meet them.
mobslearn.help.4.title: World intelligence
mobslearn.help.4.text: Overall progress of all skills. Marks from 10% to 85% unlock special skills for the whole world.
mobslearn.help.legend.title: LEGEND
mobslearn.wiki.legend.title: HOW TO READ SKILLS
mobslearn.wiki.legend.lvl: Lv %s — about %s%% of new mobs have it
mobslearn.wiki.legend.cap: So mobs can always be beaten, one mob carries at most %s skills, and at most %s of them are combat tricks.
mobslearn.wiki.tips.title: How to beat smart mobs
mobslearn.wiki.tips.sub: Even fully trained mobs can be beaten. Here's how.
mobslearn.wiki.tips.0.title: Hits break tricks
mobslearn.wiki.tips.0.text: After you hit a mob it loses its combat tricks for a second: no jumps, dodges or dashes. Strike first.
mobslearn.wiki.tips.1.title: Axe beats shield
mobslearn.wiki.tips.1.text: A shielded zombie can't block an axe hit. Axes are great against armored ones too.
mobslearn.wiki.tips.2.title: Healing runs out
mobslearn.wiki.tips.2.text: A mob retreats to heal or eats an apple only 1–2 times per fight. Chase it down — no second chances.
mobslearn.wiki.tips.3.title: Too hard?
mobslearn.wiki.tips.3.text: /mobslearn speed 0.5 slows learning down and /mobslearn reset wipes it. Operator rights needed.
mobslearn.wiki.mob.world_thresholds2: ▸ Unlocks by itself at %s%% → %s%% → %s%% world intelligence.
mobslearn.wiki.faq.6.q: Mobs got too strong. What now?
mobslearn.wiki.faq.6.a: Check the Tips above: hits break tricks, axes beat shields, mobs heal only 1–2 times. You can also slow learning with /mobslearn speed 0.5 or wipe it with /mobslearn reset.
mobslearn.wiki.faq.7.a: ●●○ is the skill level (2 of 3 here). ⚔ is a combat trick the mob uses in a fight. ✦ is an absurd skill: more funny than dangerous.
mobslearn.skill.cow_kick.desc: A cow may kick back once after your hit, then run away.
mobslearn.skill.cow_herd.desc: Touch one and the whole herd nearby comes for you.

mobslearn.skill.golem_throw.desc: Golems throw you much higher than usual.
mobslearn.skill.golem_flowers.desc: Trade well with villagers and golems gift you poppies.
mobslearn.skill.wolf_pack.desc: Wolves hit harder and live longer: +1 / +2 / +3 damage and more health.
mobslearn.skill.cat_ninelives.desc: Instead of dying the cat leaps away with half health. 1 / 2 / 3 times.

mobslearn.skill.spider_nest.desc: Weave cobweb nests. Bigger with every level.
mobslearn.skill.creeper_ambush.desc: At night they hide in leafy bushes and wait for you to come close.

mobslearn.skill.chicken_nest.desc: Chickens make hay nests and lay eggs there. Sometimes golden ones.

mobslearn.wiki.faq.8.q: Why are mobs so dumb at first?
mobslearn.wiki.faq.8.a: New-world enemies initially notice you from shorter range. Awareness reaches normal at 15% world intelligence.
mobslearn.wiki.faq.9.q: Do mobs build their own settlements?
mobslearn.wiki.faq.9.a: Yes. After watching you build, zombies build a camp, and a finished camp grows into a settlement: zombies multiply, build houses, teach each other and raid you. Villagers improve villages, clear snow and build houses for those who grow up. Found one yourself with /mobslearn settlement zombie. Needs mobGriefing.

mobslearn.colony.collapsed: The hall is destroyed and the Chief defeated — the zombie settlement has collapsed!
mobslearn.colony.fair: There's a fair in the village! Villagers gather at the bell, prices are lower
mobslearn.wiki.faq.10.q: How do I teach villagers to defend themselves?
mobslearn.wiki.faq.10.a: Walk around a village with a sword or shield. A villager will notice, come over and ask for the recipe — pick the right one of three. Each correct answer levels up Militia or Shields.
mobslearn.wiki.faq.11.q: Can I make peace with zombies?
mobslearn.wiki.faq.11.a: Yes: leave the residents alone for a while and the settlement turns neutral; right-click the Chief to trade for rare items. Hit anyone and the peace is over. To destroy a settlement, wreck the hall and defeat the Chief — the hall's chest holds a reward.
mobslearn.advancement.teacher.title: Teacher
mobslearn.advancement.teacher.desc: Tell a villager the right recipe
mobslearn.advancement.peacemaker.title: Uneasy Peace
mobslearn.advancement.chief_trade.title: Deal of the Century
mobslearn.advancement.liberator.title: Liberator
mobslearn.advancement.liberator.desc: Wreck the hall and defeat the Chief to break a settlement
mobslearn.advancement.fallen_village.des: A nearby village fell to the zombies
mobslearn.advancement.fair.title: Fair Day
mobslearn.advancement.raid_night.title: Raid Night
mobslearn.advancement.raid_night.desc: Live through a zombie settlement's raid night
mobslearn.colony.found.creeper: Creepers have claimed this place… Shhh.
mobslearn.colony.camp.start: A lonely villager set up camp here
mobslearn.colony.camp.done: The camp is ready: tent, barrel and campfire
mobslearn.colony.camp.arrival: A new villager arrived at the camp!
mobslearn.colony.camp.grown: Three villagers now — this camp becomes a new village!
mobslearn.colony.daughter: The village got crowded — villagers founded a new village nearby
mobslearn.colony.abandoned: %s: the settlement is empty and abandoned
mobslearn.colony.sortie.go: Confident of victory, the villagers attack the monster camp!
mobslearn.cmd.colony.created.skeleton: Skeleton town founded. Skeletons will appear and start building.
mobslearn.settlements.d.natural: Appeared on its own · %s days old
mobslearn.settlements.d.camp: A lone villager waits for others. With three of them it becomes a village.
mobslearn.settlements.d.chief: The chief is alive — the settlement holds
mobslearn.settlements.d.nochief: No chief! Wreck the hall and the settlement falls
mobslearn.settlements.d.tip.zombie: Zombies multiply, build houses and raid. Raid night every 4 days.
mobslearn.settlements.d.tip.skeleton: Skeletons build towers and shoot from them. Approach under cover.
mobslearn.settlements.d.tip.creeper: Creepers hide in the bushes. They don't attack villages, only players.
mobslearn.settlements.d.tip.village: Villagers build houses for the grown-ups, hold fairs and, once trained, attack monster camps themselves.
mobslearn.settlements.d.tip.ruins: Nobody lives here anymore. Over time everything crumbles under cobwebs.
mobslearn.colony.grew_away: %s: grew to level %s while you were away
mobslearn.colony.thief: You opened their chest — the whole settlement is furious!
mobslearn.colony.hero_earned: You've helped the village so much that you'll be welcomed as a hero at the fair!
mobslearn.tease.0: %1$s is typing into the void again. We can hear you, you know.
mobslearn.tease.1: "%2$s"? Seriously? Even my chicken writes better.
mobslearn.tease.3: If only you traded as much as you chat.
mobslearn.tease.4: Letters again. Should've brought emeralds instead.
mobslearn.tease.6: Did you hear that? "%2$s". Going into the Chronicle of Nonsense.
mobslearn.tease.7: Hrm! The whole village is laughing, %1$s.
mobslearn.tease.8: Who's squeaking over there? Oh, it's %1$s.
mobslearn.tease.9: They say those who type a lot build very little.
mobslearn.tease.10: My farmer is more eloquent, and he never talks.
mobslearn.tease.11: Go on, write some more. We've already baked potatoes for the show.
mobslearn.tease.12: %1$s, do you swing a sword as fast as you type?
mobslearn.tease.13: "%2$s" — ha! Oh, hold me, I can't.
mobslearn.tease.14: Keep typing. The golem remembers everything.
mobslearn.tease.15: Hrm. Who were you even talking to just now?
mobslearn.tease.16: Bet you can't say that out loud, %1$s.
mobslearn.tease.17: If words were blocks, you'd have built a castle by now.
mobslearn.tease.18: Shh, the village is sleeping. Oh wait, not anymore — thanks to you.
mobslearn.tease.19: Noting it down: %1$s is being clever again.
mobslearn.tease.20: Ah, travellers. All talk, and then the zombies eat them.
mobslearn.tease.21: Tell that to the librarian, he loves fairy tales.
mobslearn.tease.22: Hrm. Minus one emerald for that sentence.
mobslearn.tease.23: Wish you built our houses that fast, %1$s.
mobslearn.request.planks: We need %s planks to build a new house. Can you bring them? (right-click any villager while holding them)
mobslearn.request.bread: The little ones are hungry… Could you bring %s bread? (right-click a villager holding it)
mobslearn.request.iron: We could use a golem… We need %s iron ingots. (right-click a villager holding them)
mobslearn.request.torch: Nights are scary here. Could you bring %s torches? (right-click a villager holding them)
mobslearn.request.thanks.planks: Thank you! We're starting a new house.
mobslearn.request.thanks.bread: Thank you! Now there's enough for the little ones.
mobslearn.request.thanks.iron: Thank you! Our new golem owes you one.
mobslearn.request.thanks.torch: Thank you! With lights, the village grows faster.
mobslearn.ask.question.pickaxe: How do you make a pickaxe?
mobslearn.ask.question.axe: How do you make an axe?
mobslearn.ask.thanks.pickaxe: Thanks! With pickaxes we'll build faster.
mobslearn.ask.thanks.axe: Thanks! Now we can chop our own wood.
mobslearn.skill.villager_tools.desc: Teach villagers the pickaxe and axe recipes — they build faster and the village can grow a level higher.
mobslearn.skill.villager_dance.desc: Jump near villagers and they dance along. Level 1: hops, 2: plus spins, 3: plus arm waves and head shakes. The higher the level, the more dancers.
mobslearn.skill.villager_tease.desc: Villagers tease you when you chat, and sometimes just out of the blue as you pass by. The higher the level, the more often.
mobslearn.trigger.taught_tools: you teach villagers the right pickaxe and axe recipes
mobslearn.trigger.see_armor: they see you wearing armor or picking it up
mobslearn.advancement.dance_floor.title: Everybody Dance!!
mobslearn.advancement.teased.title: Sharp Tongue
mobslearn.advancement.watched.title: Under Observation
mobslearn.advancement.watched.desc: Notice a zombie studying how you build
mobslearn.advancement.village_guard.desc: Help a village several times and earn hero status
mobslearn.colony.help_progress: Request done: %s of %s. A few more and you'll be the village hero.
mobslearn.tease.ambient.0: %1$s, walking in circles again? We noticed.
mobslearn.tease.ambient.1: Hrm. You again. Brought emeralds, or just here to stare?
mobslearn.tease.ambient.2: Hey, %1$s! You look like someone who lost their pickaxe.
mobslearn.tease.ambient.3: Does anyone know why he's standing here? Just standing.
mobslearn.tease.ambient.4: Hm-hm-hm. Keep staring like that and I'll start charging.
mobslearn.tease.ambient.5: %1$s, your shoelace is untied. Oh wait, you have no laces.
mobslearn.tease.ambient.6: They say villagers are politer in the next village. Just rumours, of course.
mobslearn.tease.ambient.7: Walked right past — no hello, not even a hrm. Rude.
mobslearn.tease.ambient.8: Look, %1$s is here! Hide the carrots.
mobslearn.tease.ambient.9: I'd chat, but I'm busy. Very important things. Hrm.
mobslearn.tease.ambient.10: Have you seen my bed? Oh, it's right there. Never mind.
mobslearn.tease.ambient.11: Not saying anything, but you look suspiciously heroic.
mobslearn.tease.ambient.12: Trample my crops and I'll remember it.
mobslearn.tease.ambient.13: %1$s, can you even dance? Jump, let's see.
mobslearn.wiki.group.pillager: Crossbow and axe raiders. They hide behind shields, copy your armor and fire in bursts.
mobslearn.skill.pillager_shield.desc: Hit them with a sword or axe and they come with a shield, sometimes blocking frontal hits. Axes break shields.
mobslearn.skill.pillager_armor.desc: They see you in armor and put on the same: helmet → + chestplate → full set.
mobslearn.skill.pillager_sniper.desc: You kill with arrows and crossbows, so they learn Quick Charge (I–III) and spot you 4 / 8 / 12 blocks farther.
mobslearn.skill.pillager_strafe.desc: They saw how you dodge and now circle around you in close combat.
mobslearn.skill.pillager_copycat.desc: They dress like you: copying your helmet, then boots, then chestplate.
mobslearn.wiki.settle.title: The world builds itself
mobslearn.wiki.settle.sub: Villages, zombie camps, skeleton towers and creeper groves grow on their own.
mobslearn.wiki.settle.1.title: How they start
mobslearn.wiki.settle.1.text: Monsters only build a camp once they have learned the building skill. First a camp, then a main building, houses and a fence.
mobslearn.wiki.settle.2.title: Growth
mobslearn.wiki.settle.2.text: Every few days a new level: more houses and residents.
mobslearn.wiki.settle.3.title: Neighbours
mobslearn.wiki.settle.3.text: Nearby settlements make friends or go to war. Two zombie camps can merge into a big town.
mobslearn.wiki.settle.4.title: While you're away
mobslearn.wiki.settle.4.text: Settlements keep growing without you. You can speed time up in settings: "Simulation speed".
mobslearn.wiki.settle.5.title: Peace
mobslearn.wiki.settle.5.text: Leave a camp alone and it becomes peaceful; its leader will trade with you.
mobslearn.wiki.settle.6.title: Clearing
mobslearn.wiki.settle.6.text: Kill the leader and nearly all residents and the camp is abandoned.
mobslearn.wiki.vill.title: A living village
mobslearn.wiki.vill.sub: Villagers remember you, ask for help, chat and learn.
mobslearn.wiki.vill.1.title: Requests
mobslearn.wiki.vill.1.text: Right-click a villager: they may ask for planks, bread or iron.
mobslearn.wiki.vill.2.title: Hero
mobslearn.wiki.vill.2.text: Help the village a few times and they will greet you as a hero.
mobslearn.wiki.vill.3.title: Learning
mobslearn.wiki.vill.3.text: Give a villager a sword, shield or pickaxe and they learn to defend and build.
mobslearn.wiki.vill.4.title: Dancing
mobslearn.wiki.vill.4.text: Jump next to villagers and they dance.
mobslearn.wiki.vill.5.title: Teasing
mobslearn.wiki.vill.5.text: Type in chat nearby and they will mock you.
mobslearn.wiki.vill.6.title: Fear
mobslearn.wiki.vill.6.text: Hit villagers and they call golems and remember it for a long time.
mobslearn.trade.sub.zombie: While you leave the camp alone, the chief will trade
mobslearn.trade.sub.skeleton: While you leave the town alone, the captain swaps bones for loot
mobslearn.trade.sub.creeper: While you leave the grove alone, the elder trades gunpowder
mobslearn.cmd.ai.key: Key saved to config/mobslearn-ai.json. Turn on: /mobslearn ai on
mobslearn.cmd.ai.hint: Without a key the built-in replies work. Free key: console.groq.com, then /mobslearn ai key <key> and /mobslearn ai on. Or locally: /mobslearn ai preset ollama
mobslearn.chat.insult.0: Hrm! Look who's talking, %1$s. Didn't anyone teach you manners?
mobslearn.chat.insult.1: "%3$s"? I'll remember that, %1$s. Your prices just went up.
mobslearn.chat.insult.2: Hrm. That hurts, you know. Go hang out with the zombies, %1$s.
mobslearn.chat.insult_hard.0: That's it, %1$s, I've had enough! Get out of my village, you lout!
mobslearn.chat.insult_hard.1: May a creeper hug you, %1$s! You won't see another emerald from me!
mobslearn.chat.insult_hard.2: Hrm! One more word and I call the golem, %1$s. He doesn't like your kind.
mobslearn.chat.sorry.0: Hrm... Fine, I forgive you. But I remember everything, %1$s.
mobslearn.chat.sorry.1: Apology accepted. An emerald as a peace offering would be nice.
mobslearn.chat.sorry.2: Well, at least you have a conscience, %1$s. Peace.
mobslearn.chat.sorry_none.0: For what? You haven't done anything bad. Yet.
mobslearn.chat.sorry_none.1: Hrm? Suspicious. What have you done already, %1$s?
mobslearn.chat.sorry_none.2: Nothing to apologise for. Better buy something.
mobslearn.chat.thanks.0: You're welcome, %1$s. Come again, I have discounts... sometimes.
mobslearn.chat.thanks.2: No problem. Just don't tell anyone I'm nice.
mobslearn.chat.how.0: Hrm. Fine, until the zombies show up. How about you, %1$s?
mobslearn.chat.how.1: Crops are growing, emeralds are piling up. Life is good.
mobslearn.chat.how.2: My neighbour snored all night again. Otherwise fine.
mobslearn.chat.name.0: I'm %2$s. A local celebrity, by the way.
mobslearn.chat.name.1: They call me %2$s. And I already know you, %1$s.
mobslearn.chat.name.2: Hrm. %2$s. Remember it, might come in handy.
mobslearn.chat.praise.0: Oh, stop it, %1$s... No, go on.
mobslearn.chat.praise.1: Hrm! Now that's a well-mannered person.
mobslearn.chat.praise.2: You're not bad yourself, %1$s. For a human.
mobslearn.chat.greet.1: Oh, %1$s! Long time no see. Well, since this morning.
mobslearn.chat.greet.2: Greetings, traveller. Wipe your feet, it's clean here.
mobslearn.chat.bye.0: Bye, %1$s. Don't get caught by zombies.
mobslearn.chat.bye.2: Off you go. I'll miss you. A little.
mobslearn.chat.trade.0: Emeralds? You've come to the right villager! Right-click to see my goods.
mobslearn.chat.trade.1: For you, %1$s, special prices. Especially high ones. Kidding. Probably.
mobslearn.chat.trade.2: Hrm. I love trading more than sleeping. Show me what you've got.
mobslearn.chat.trade_no.0: After everything you said? I won't sell you even a stick.
mobslearn.chat.trade_no.1: Hrm! Apologise first, %1$s, then we talk money.
mobslearn.chat.trade_no.2: Prices for rude people are triple. That's that.
mobslearn.chat.help.0: You want to help? Hrm, let me think of something...
mobslearn.chat.help.1: The village always needs hands. And torches. And bread.
mobslearn.chat.help.2: Help us a few times and you'll be the village hero.
mobslearn.chat.danger.0: Shh! Zombies have got smart lately. They build camps, can you imagine?
mobslearn.chat.danger.1: Hrm. If you see a raid, defend us. We'll repay you.
mobslearn.chat.danger.2: Monsters learn from your habits. So behave yourself.
mobslearn.chat.joke.0: Why don't creepers go to parties? They always blow up emotionally.
mobslearn.chat.joke.1: A zombie visits the doctor: "I don't feel well." - "Do you feel at all?"
mobslearn.chat.joke.2: Hrm-hrm-hrm. That's me laughing, by the way.
mobslearn.chat.question.0: Hrm. Good question, %1$s. Ask the librarian, he's smart.
mobslearn.chat.question.1: How should I know? I water the garden here.
mobslearn.chat.question.2: "%3$s"? Hrm... I'll answer for an emerald.
mobslearn.chat.other.0: Hrm. Interesting, %1$s. Didn't understand a thing, but interesting.
mobslearn.journal.soon.empty: Nobody is learning anything yet. Play a bit and the mobs will start watching.
mobslearn.journal.world_why: Because mobs know more and more in total
mobslearn.journal.none: No entries in this group yet.
mobslearn.skill.world_herd.desc: Cows, sheep, pigs, chickens, rabbits and horses scatter when you walk up holding a weapon.
mobslearn.skill.world_doors.desc: Hostile mobs chasing you can open wooden doors.
mobslearn.skill.world_torches.desc: At night hostile mobs near you snuff out torches and knock them down.
mobslearn.skill.world_track.desc: All hostile mobs notice you 8 blocks farther away.
mobslearn.skill.world_ears.desc: Sprinting at night lets hostile mobs within 20 blocks hear you and come over.
mobslearn.skill.world_storm.desc: During a thunderstorm hostile mobs get faster and stronger.
mobslearn.skill.world_pack.desc: Hit a hostile mob and up to four of its kin nearby rush at you.
mobslearn.colony.grudge: %s: they are glaring at you, you are causing harm. A bit more and they will chase you out.
mobslearn.colony.banned: You are being chased out of the settlement (%s)! Apologise to a villager or pay emeralds (right-click a villager or the chief holding emeralds).
mobslearn.colony.forgiven: %s: you have been forgiven. Behave yourself.
mobslearn.colony.paid: You paid %s emeralds. You still need %s to make up for it fully.
mobslearn.colony.moved: The village ran out of homes, so some villagers moved far away and founded a new settlement.
mobslearn.settlements.d.wood: Wood stock: %s (foresters chop trees; no new houses without wood)
mobslearn.settlements.d.grudge: They hold a grudge against you: %s of 20
mobslearn.settlements.d.banned: You are banned here. Pay %s emeralds or apologise
mobslearn.chat.notrade.0: I won't trade with you, %1$s. Make amends first.
mobslearn.chat.notrade.1: Hrm! Thief and lout. Emeralds first, then we talk.
mobslearn.chat.notrade.2: The whole village knows what you did. Apologise.
mobslearn.chat.weather.0: Hrm, weather is weather. Just no thunderstorms, zombies get nastier after them.
mobslearn.chat.weather.1: Rain is good for the crops. But it gets down my collar.
mobslearn.chat.food.0: Our bread is tasty. We grow the wheat ourselves.
mobslearn.chat.food.1: Hungry? Bring bread to the village and everyone will love you.
mobslearn.chat.food.2: Hrm. A carrot beats any stew.
mobslearn.chat.work.0: Working, as you can see. Hrm. Well, almost.
mobslearn.chat.work.1: We build houses, chop trees, water the crops. And you?
mobslearn.chat.work.2: My job is being %2$s. Very important work.
mobslearn.chat.family.0: I have a big family. Half the village is related.
mobslearn.chat.family.1: The kids are running around here somewhere. Don't hurt them.
mobslearn.chat.family.2: Hrm. Family is when there are enough beds for everyone.
mobslearn.chat.night.0: At night I sleep. I suggest you do too: zombies don't.
mobslearn.chat.night.1: The bed is the best invention after emeralds.
mobslearn.chat.golem.0: Our golem is the best guard. Don't make him angry.
mobslearn.chat.golem.1: The golem gives flowers to kids. To you, only smacks.
mobslearn.chat.golem.2: Hrm. Made of iron, but a heart of gold.
mobslearn.chat.home.0: Our village is growing. Soon it will be a town. Probably.
mobslearn.chat.home.1: Every adult gets their own home. That's our rule.
mobslearn.chat.home.2: We build houses from whatever the foresters chop.
mobslearn.chat.greet.3: Hrm! %1$s! Come in, just wipe your feet.
mobslearn.chat.greet.4: Hi, hi. Lots of news, few emeralds.
mobslearn.chat.how.3: Hrm. My back hurts, otherwise great.
mobslearn.chat.how.4: Better than that zombie across the river.
mobslearn.chat.other.3: Hrm. I'll think about it. In a hundred years.
mobslearn.chat.question.3: Ask the village elder. Though we don't have one.
mobslearn.chat.question.4: Hrm. If I knew, I'd be a librarian.
mobslearn.chat.insult.3: Name-calling is the lowest, %1$s. Even zombies are more polite.
mobslearn.chat.insult.4: Hrm! I'll remember that at the fair.
mobslearn.wiki.vill.7.title: Reputation
mobslearn.wiki.vill.7.text: Break, steal or run around armed and you get kicked out. Make peace: apologise in chat or pay emeralds.
mobslearn.wiki.vill.8.title: Foresters
mobslearn.wiki.vill.8.text: They chop and plant trees. No wood, no new houses.
mobslearn.chatter.did.0: dropped an anvil into the well
mobslearn.chatter.did.1: sold a cow for three emeralds
mobslearn.chatter.did.3: found a diamond in a pile of manure
mobslearn.chatter.did.4: built a house without a door
mobslearn.chatter.did.7: mixed up a healing potion with poison
mobslearn.chatter.did.9: got lost in his own garden
mobslearn.chatter.did.10: traded his boat for a bucket of sand
mobslearn.chatter.did.11: saw a glowing squid in a puddle
mobslearn.chatter.did.12: burned a pie and blamed the dragon
mobslearn.chatter.did.14: dug a hole all the way to bedrock
mobslearn.chatter.did.15: lost his hat in the Nether
mobslearn.chatter.did.18: ate seven carrots in one go
mobslearn.chatter.did.19: caught a fish as big as a boat
mobslearn.chatter.did.20: won a bet against a witch
mobslearn.chatter.did.24: sold a map to his own house
mobslearn.chatter.did.25: hid his emeralds and forgot where
mobslearn.chatter.did.27: got scared of his own echo
mobslearn.chatter.did.28: saw an enderman wearing a hat
mobslearn.chatter.did.29: got stuck in a cobweb all night
mobslearn.chatter.did.30: tried to eat an iron ingot
mobslearn.chatter.twist.0: and now an echo lives there
mobslearn.chatter.twist.1: and now everyone calls him a hero
mobslearn.chatter.twist.3: and he hasn't eaten carrots since
mobslearn.chatter.twist.4: and the whole village laughed for a week
mobslearn.chatter.twist.6: and got three emeralds for it
mobslearn.chatter.twist.7: and now he wears a pumpkin on his head
mobslearn.chatter.twist.9: and became the richest in the area
mobslearn.chatter.twist.12: and the zombies walked in circles for a week
mobslearn.chatter.twist.13: and now there's a statue there
mobslearn.chatter.twist.15: and wheat doesn't grow there anymore
mobslearn.chatter.open.3: At the fair they said %3$s from %2$s %4$s.
mobslearn.chatter.open.6: A little bird told me %3$s from %2$s %4$s.
mobslearn.chatter.more.1: My cousin told me, and he never lies.
mobslearn.chatter.more.2: Hrm, maybe I exaggerated a little.
mobslearn.chatter.more.3: I didn't believe it until I saw it.
mobslearn.chatter.react.6: Hrm-hrm... and where do emeralds come in?
mobslearn.chatter.react.7: I've heard this three times already.
mobslearn.chatter.react.9: That's what I'm saying: strange folk over there.
mobslearn.chatter.react.10: Hrm. I'll have to check that.
mobslearn.chatter.react.12: I thought you meant our blacksmith.
mobslearn.chatter.react.13: It's all because of the full moon.
mobslearn.chatter.react.18: That's why I never go there.
mobslearn.chatter.react.19: Hrm... I wonder what the elder will say.
mobslearn.chatter.pair.0.a: %1$s, how many emeralds do you have?
mobslearn.chatter.pair.1.a: The wheat is lovely this year.
mobslearn.chatter.pair.1.b: As long as the crows don't get it.
mobslearn.chatter.pair.2.a: Zombies were groaning under the windows again last night.
mobslearn.chatter.pair.2.b: I covered my ears with a pillow.
mobslearn.chatter.pair.4.b: Bread. Like yesterday. And the day before.
mobslearn.chatter.pair.5.a: Seen how %2$s jumps around? Like a rabbit.
mobslearn.chatter.pair.5.b: Hrm, maybe they are a rabbit.
mobslearn.chatter.pair.6.a: The foresters say we're running out of trees.
mobslearn.chatter.pair.6.b: Let them plant instead of complaining.
mobslearn.chatter.pair.7.a: Did you hear the rooster? Wait, we don't have a rooster.
mobslearn.chatter.pair.8.a: I want to be a librarian.
mobslearn.chatter.pair.9.b: At least the zombies are slower.
mobslearn.chatter.pair.10.a: Who left the door open again?
mobslearn.chatter.pair.11.a: I dreamed I was a dragon.
mobslearn.chatter.pair.12.a: The fair is soon, I need to sell pumpkins.
mobslearn.chatter.pair.12.b: Who'll buy them? Everyone has pumpkins.
mobslearn.chatter.pair.14.a: My garden is the best in the village.
mobslearn.chatter.pair.14.b: Hrm, mine is the second best.
mobslearn.chatter.pair.15.b: No need for a bed, it's all bones.
mobslearn.chatter.pair.18.b: After the rain. Or the next one.
mobslearn.chatter.pair.19.a: Do you think the Nether is real?
mobslearn.chatter.pair.19.b: Hrm, my cousin lost his hat there.
mobslearn.chatter.about.1: They say %1$s is friends with zombies.
mobslearn.chatter.about.2: Hrm, %1$s looks like someone with emeralds.
mobslearn.chatter.about.3: %2$s, don't look at %1$s or they'll want to trade.
mobslearn.chatter.about.6: %1$s hit a chicken yesterday. I saw everything.
mobslearn.chatter.wood.0: We're almost out of wood, and houses won't build themselves.
mobslearn.chatter.wood.1: The foresters are off somewhere again.
mobslearn.chatter.night.0: Time to go home, the zombies will be out soon.
mobslearn.chatter.night.1: Last one in shuts the doors.
mobslearn.chatter.night.2: Hrm, I'm not giving my bed to anyone.
mobslearn.chat.swear.0: Hrm! Mind your language, there are kids around.
mobslearn.chat.swear.1: Oh my, such words, %1$s! Wash your mouth with soap.
mobslearn.chat.swear.2: Hrm, my grandpa swore like that when he dropped an anvil on his foot.
mobslearn.chat.swear.4: Ew, %1$s. Even zombies don't talk like that.
mobslearn.chat.swear.5: Hrm. I've only heard words like that from pillagers.
mobslearn.wiki.vill.9.title: Chatter
mobslearn.wiki.vill.9.text: They chat and tell stories. Say "Villagers!" and several will answer.
mobslearn.colony.neutral.zombie: The zombie settlement got used to you and no longer attacks. You can trade with the chief!
mobslearn.colony.angry.zombie: You attacked a resident — the zombies are hostile again!
mobslearn.colony.raidnight.zombie: Raid night! All the zombies are out hunting
mobslearn.colony.village_raid.zombie: Zombies from a nearby settlement attacked the village!
mobslearn.colony.village_fell.zombie: The village has fallen. The zombies took it over
mobslearn.colony.collapsed.zombie: The hall is wrecked and the chief is gone — the zombie settlement fell apart!
mobslearn.colony.neutral.skeleton: The skeleton town got used to you and no longer attacks. You can trade with the captain!
mobslearn.colony.angry.skeleton: You attacked a resident — the skeletons are hostile again!
mobslearn.colony.raidnight.skeleton: Raid night! All the skeletons are out hunting
mobslearn.colony.village_raid.skeleton: Skeletons from a nearby settlement attacked the village!
mobslearn.colony.village_fell.skeleton: The village has fallen. The skeletons took it over
mobslearn.colony.collapsed.skeleton: The tower is wrecked and the captain is gone — the skeleton town fell apart!
mobslearn.colony.neutral.creeper: The creeper grove got used to you and no longer attacks. You can trade with the elder!
mobslearn.colony.angry.creeper: You attacked a resident — the creepers are hostile again!
mobslearn.colony.raidnight.creeper: Raid night! All the creepers are out hunting
mobslearn.colony.village_raid.creeper: Creepers from a nearby settlement attacked the village!
mobslearn.colony.village_fell.creeper: The village has fallen. The creepers took it over
mobslearn.colony.collapsed.creeper: The grove is destroyed and the elder is gone — the creepers scattered!
mobslearn.colony.war: Two settlements (%s and %s) are fighting over land — war!
mobslearn.colony.war_end: The war is over: %s drove out their neighbours (%s).
mobslearn.colony.alliance: Two neighbouring settlements (%s) merged into one big town! They are building houses between them.
mobslearn.colony.cleared: You killed the leader and nearly everyone: the settlement (%s) is abandoned.
mobslearn.chatter.friend.0: Our friends from %1$s sent us planks. Good folk.
mobslearn.chatter.friend.1: %2$s, shall we go to the fair in %1$s? Our friends are there.
mobslearn.chatter.friend.2: They bake the best bread in %1$s. We're friends with them.
mobslearn.chatter.friend.3: Hrm, if anything happens, the folk from %1$s will help us.
